After-Visit Summary -- Marrowgate Regional Medical Center Ambulatory Burn Follow-up
Dear Mr Pruitt, Dear [PATIENT],
Thank you for coming in on Friday, October 16, 2076. You were seen for a partial thickness burn of your right forearm and hand. It has healed well over the past 3 weeks.
Patient: Garrett L Pruitt DOB: 03/09/2027 Age: 49 Your provider today: Dr. Harold Teague
WHAT WE DID - Looked at the wound, removed the old dressing. - Stopped your antibiotic (cefuroxime) and acetaminophen as of today. - The meperidine should be finished by 11/01/2076. Do not drive while taking it.
WHAT TO DO AT HOME 1. Keep the skin moisturised and out of the sun. 2. Call us if you see redness, pus or fever. 3. Your sleep apnea still needs treatment. Please ask Dr. Oduya about a new CPAP mask. 4. Prediabetes: HbA1c was 6.3 last year, we will check again at your yearly visit.
Your wife Marisol asked about going back to work at Calloway Freight Systems. Light duty only until cleared. A letter was sent to the HR office.
Questions? Call 937-555-0171 or use the portal, username gpruitt_kett27. Pls dont reply to this auto message.
